questions.question: Decision 2 of 4. The parser needs real Trade Market pages, and both earlier fetches were rate-limited (429). How should the first 2–3 pages be obtained?

options.label: You save them (Recommended)
options.description: You open 2–3 playertrades pages in your own browser and save them (File → Save Page As) into the plan's captures folder. No automated requests. It also shows whether a sign-in is needed.

options.label: Claude in Chrome reads
options.description: Claude opens at most 3 pages in one tab of your Chrome, 60 s apart, while you watch. It stops on any 429 or challenge.

options.label: One server canary
options.description: One server-side fetch of one page under a per-action approval. It may hit 429 again, and it can't use a sign-in if the page needs one.

questions.question: Decision 3 of 4. Once the scraper runs, which players should it collect, and how often?

options.label: BLSH-listed, daily (Recommended)
options.description: Players on the current BLSH lists (up to 100), at most 60 pages a day, one at a time, 60 s or more apart. Stops on the first 429. Page views read only stored rows.

options.label: On demand per view
options.description: Fetch a player's page when someone opens that player, then cache it. Traffic decides the volume, so it can spike and trip 429s.

options.label: Wider daily universe
options.description: All rostered NHL skaters and goalies (about 700), paced over a week at the same spacing. Wider coverage, about 10× the requests.

user_tool_response.content: Your questions have been answered: "Decision 3 of 4. Once the scraper runs, which players should it collect, and how often?"="Wider daily universe". You can now continue with these answers in mind.

questions.question: Decision 4 of 4. What should the pipeline's own first player valuation be (kept separate from observed trades)?

options.label: Value over replacement (Recommended)
options.description: Qualified FORGE horizon production under the league's scoring, minus a replacement level set by that league's team count and roster slots. Unavailable when FORGE or scoring is missing.

options.label: Raw projected points
options.description: Qualified FORGE horizon totals under league scoring, with no replacement adjustment (what compareTrade does now). Simpler, but it ignores league size and positions.

options.label: Defer valuations
options.description: Ship observed trades first and build valuations later. Products show 'Valuation unavailable' until then.

questions.question: Follow-up on decision 4. Decision 6 says ADP is context, not a trade price. How should ADP stop 'waiver junk for McDavid' ideas?

options.label: Plausibility guard (Recommended)
options.description: ADP never enters the value number. Trade ideas whose sides are far apart in ADP tier are flagged or held back as implausible, and the ADP gap is shown as context.

options.label: Weighted value input
options.description: ADP becomes one weighted part of the player value, next to VOR and season-to-date totals. This amends decision 6's 'not a price' rule, and the weight needs its own testing.
